item.text: {"verdict":"accurate","confidence":0.98,"rationale":"参考摘录逐字载有该句，并由上下文确认这是《奥德赛》第9卷中奥德修斯向独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯自称“Noman”的话，所给行号亦相符。","cited_evidence":["“my name is Noman; this is what my father and mother and my friends have always called me.”","“Cyclops, you ask my name and I will tell it you”","“I then gave him some more”"]}
